name: nms-dashboard
description: NMS Dashboard — Spring Boot REST backend, the MCP server in front of it, and the Angular frontend. Root scripts drive all three.

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && mvn -q -B -f backend/pom.xml package -DskipTests && mvn -q -B -f mcp-server/pom.xml package -DskipTests
scripts.test: mvn -q -B -f backend/pom.xml test && mvn -q -B -f mcp-server/pom.xml test
